about.intro_en: I am a second-year Digital Media and Culture student at King's College London, focused on communicating complex social and cultural ideas clearly to diverse audiences. At People's Daily, I planned a three-episode archaeological live broadcast, developed a ten-episode documentary framework on Chinese food culture and researched a Channel 4 series to support a Sino-foreign co-production. With experience in journalism, drama and teaching, systematic training and nearly ten years of independent programming, and a quick command of AI tools, I turn ideas into thoughtful, accessible and innovative media. I am seeking media and marketing internships.
about.intro_zh: 我是伦敦国王学院数字媒体与文化专业二年级本科生，专注于向不同受众清晰传达复杂的社会与文化议题。在人民日报实习期间，我策划了三集考古直播，搭建了十集中餐文化纪录片的内容框架，并调研英国第四频道节目，为中外合拍项目提供支持。我拥有新闻、戏剧和教学经历，接受过系统的编程训练并有近十年的独立编程经验，能快速上手 AI 工具，致力于创作有思想、易理解、有创新的媒体内容。目前正在寻找传媒和营销方向的实习机会。

design.title_zh: 班会专业简介：新闻传播学
design.detail_zh: 以张雪峰“报考新闻学”言论风波为引，谈新闻制造与新闻理想：从《新闻女王》《新闻编辑室》《白日之下》等影视，到“文科作为服务业到底服务了谁”。
design.detail_en: Opening with a viral debate over studying journalism (Mandarin): news-making vs journalistic ideals through films from The Newsreader to Spotlight — asking whom the humanities serve.
design.intro_zh: 这是高中时期一次班会上的专业介绍讲演，主题是新闻传播学。讲演以张雪峰“劝退”新闻学考生的言论风波开场，讨论“新闻已死”论调背后的真相：新闻行业或许式微，但“制造新闻”从未停止。从《新闻女王》到《聚焦》《白日之下》，讲演用影视案例拆解新闻生产中的取舍与操纵，进而追问——如果文科都是服务业，它到底服务了谁？结尾落在《聚焦》的那句 Break the Story, Break the Silence，以及《白日之下》中“十年之后还会不会有记者”的拷问。
design.intro_en: A class-meeting talk introducing journalism studies (Mandarin). Opening with a viral debate over whether to study journalism, it contrasts the decline of the news industry with the boom of news-making — through films from The Newsreader to Spotlight — and closes with In Broad Daylight's question: will there still be journalists ten years from now?

design.detail_zh: 39 页课堂讲演：从托尔斯泰的生平与出走之死讲起，重述聂赫留朵夫与玛丝洛娃的“复活”，并以福柯、康德与列宁对照托尔斯泰主义的道德自我完善与不以暴力抗恶。
design.detail_en: A 39-slide literature-class talk (Mandarin): Tolstoy's life and flight, the twin resurrections of Nekhlyudov and Maslova, read through Foucault, Kant and Lenin.
design.intro_zh: 语文课堂上的托尔斯泰专题讲演，共 39 页。从托尔斯泰的贵族出身、出走与去世讲起，重述《复活》中聂赫留朵夫与玛丝洛娃两条“复活”的轨迹，并引入三重视角：福柯的规训与惩罚、康德的道德哲学、列宁的革命镜说，最终落到托尔斯泰主义的核心——道德的自我完善与不以暴力抗恶。
design.intro_en: A 39-slide literature-class talk on Tolstoy's Resurrection (Mandarin): Tolstoy's life and flight, the twin resurrections of Nekhlyudov and Maslova, read through Foucault, Kant and Lenin toward Tolstoyan moral self-perfection and non-resistance.

design.title_zh: 政治课堂讲演：中国房地产改革40年
design.title_en: 40 Years of Housing Reform in China (Mandarin)
design.detail_zh: 38 页课堂讲演：以典型城市人口“平房—套二—套三—买房—新房”的居住变迁史为线，串起 1979–2022 年住房商品化、产业化与回归居住属性的三阶段，兼引黄奇帆、兰小欢与吴晓波。
design.detail_en: A 38-slide classroom talk (Mandarin): the residential trajectory of a typical urban population — from bungalows to mortgaged flats — tracing three stages of reform from 1979 to 2022.
design.intro_zh: 政治课堂讲演用 38 页梳理中国房地产改革 40 年。讲演以典型城市人口的居住变迁史（平房、套二、套三、买房、新房）为线索，串起三个阶段：1979–1996 年商品化开启、1997–2014 年产业化拉动增长、2015 年之后回归居住属性。理论上兼引黄奇帆的市场分析、兰小欢《置身事内》的政府视角与吴晓波的商业史叙述，收束于“房住不炒”与“那是一个好的时代”。
design.intro_en: A politics-class talk in 38 slides (Mandarin): the housing changes of a typical urban population frame three stages of reform — commercialization (1979–1996), industrialization (1997–2014), and the return to housing-as-shelter — with Huang Qifan, Lan Xiaohuan and Wu Xiaobo.
